terms.gloss: tag, you’re it! now you chase
terms.comment: A description of ours from plain classical words: tangere, touch, and sequī, go after. We have found no Latin name for the game of tag, and no formula for passing on the chase, in Lewis & Short, the loci collections, Traupman, Morgan–Owens, or Levi–Bini. For the chase, see “chase”; for the threat, see “I’m gonna get you!”; for the freezing game, see “you’re stone”.

phrases.english: Whoever I touch will be it.

sources: Lewis & Short: tango · Lewis & Short: sequor · Lewis & Short: consequor
